name: Seu Jorge (Licit)
origem: previa A (provisoria, a confirmar pelo usuario)
descricao: A 62-year-old Brazilian man, veteran owner of a small construction company, former site foreman. Native Brazilian Portuguese. Deep, gravelly, slow voice, few words, skeptical and dry, with the weight of someone who has been burned before. Natural conversational delivery, not an announcer. Clean studio recording.
